body.statement:
Does there exist a single finite rule list \(\mathcal R_{\mathrm{SI}}\subset\Lambda_{\mathrm{SI}}\), with schemata independent of \(D\) and \(K\), that uses only the observable premises permitted by \(\Lambda_{\mathrm{SI}}\), is sound over every compatibility fiber, and has the following unknown-\(A\) graphical extension property? For every residual reported circle endpoint and each requested mark \(m\in\{\mathtt{tail},\mathtt{arrow}\}\), the extension supplies a compatible base model and an admissible replacement graph, without guessing \(A\) in a rule premise or invoking a global feasibility query, such that every fully specified member of the corresponding realization fiber has mark \(m\). The affirmative answer must preserve the complete observational and pooled-law signatures, including indicator-involving adjacencies and unshielded colliders, and must respect
\[
 Z_k=T_k\cup\bigl((F_k\setminus T_k)\cap A\bigr)
\]
without setting \(T_k=Z_k\). Together with an affirmative answer to the faithful-realization question, this observable graphical extension property implies the conditional completeness theorem; neither affirmative answer is established here.
body.justification: The revised future problem isolates the finite observable unknown-\(A\) graphical extension theorem.
body.gap: No local construction synchronizes unknown selection membership and a common exterior completion across all pooled regimes.
body.consumer: Together with faithful realization, an affirmative answer would activate the conditional completeness theorem.

obligation.what_is_open: Construct a fixed finite observable rule list and prove the unknown-selection common-exterior graphical extension property for both marks at every residual circle, without latent-A rule premises or a global realizability query.
obligation.obstruction: Observable selectedness certificates provide only a sound subset of every feasible ancestral selected set. They do not locally choose the remaining selection membership and one exterior basal completion while preserving all regime fill edges and indicator collider signatures.
obligation.attempted: Combined the selectedness closure with the exact singleton fixed-A cases and the empty-graph/simple-path graphical specifications. These ingredients do not synchronize varying compatible ancestral selected sets or the shared exterior completion.
obligation.partial_result: Observable selectedness closure is sound, and the fixed-\(A\) theorem gives the nonempty bracket \(\mathcal M_A\subseteq\mathcal G_A\), exact singleton identification, and two signature-preserving graphical specifications in the two-mark case. If faithful realization is affirmative and a fixed observable rule list supplies the stated unknown-\(A\) graphical extension for both marks at every residual circle, then the conditional completeness theorem proves equality with the canonical SI-PAG and the existing saturation proposition gives polynomially many updates. No such finite unknown-\(A\) extension theorem is established.
